title: micranthes clusii subsp. lepismigena
intro: Micranthes clusii subsp. lepismigena, commonly known as Alpine Bistort or Lepismigena, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the saxifrage family (Saxifragaceae). This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and acting as an anti-diarrheal agent. The therapeutic actions of Micranthes clusii subsp. lepismigena include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being studied, but they are believed to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may be responsible for its therapeutic effects.
